title: LLM Inference Service
description: A fast, secure local LLM inference service with API-key authentication, rate limiting, latency tracking, and structured logging. Runs open-source models locally, exposes both custom and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and includes a dashboard for testing and monitoring. Docker-ready and easy to deploy.

title: leX
description: A lightweight and educational version control system (VCS) built from scratch in C++. Supports staging, object storage, hashing, and custom indexing for tracking file changes without using any external VCS.

title: ckr blog
description: A personal blog website built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and MDX. It features a clean and responsive design and allows for easy content creation using Markdown.

title: micrograd
description: Rebuilt and experimented with a Python-based autodiff engine inspired by Karpathy's Macrograd, with custom extensions for deeper exploration.
